name: Pad
description: Places the picture on a larger canvas of one colour; the output has the size of the canvas.

params.name: w
params.description: Width of the canvas in pixels; 0 = the input's width

params.name: h
params.description: Height of the canvas in pixels; 0 = the input's height

params.name: x
params.description: Left edge of the picture on the canvas; -1 = centred

params.name: y
params.description: Top edge of the picture on the canvas; -1 = centred
